name: The session ended in another tab: the websocket does not knock with the dead token, shows the popup, keeps trying with a growing delay
description: The renewal on reconnect fails (the OIDC provider answers that the session is over): no handshake, the popup names the websocket request. "No" keeps the popup closed for a while; the client retries the renewal after a doubling delay and never a handshake without a token, so it comes back by itself once a token is available again.
